versions.name: Git clone
versions.description: Clone a Git repository into a workspace subdirectory (branch or tag, optional shallow, optional token for private HTTPS repos).
versions.description_zh: 将 Git 仓库克隆到 workspace 子目录（支持分支/标签、浅克隆，可选 token 访问私有 HTTPS 仓库）。
versions.author: buz maintainers

versions.name: Git clone
versions.description: Clone a Git repository into the `into` directory (default source) inside the workspace, without overwriting an existing path.
versions.description_zh: 将 Git 仓库克隆到 workspace 内的 into 目录（默认 source），禁止覆盖已有路径。
versions.author: buz maintainers
